title: Padmé on Top of Things
front_description: Facing the arena creatures, Obi-Wan turns to Anakin: "Just relax. Concentrate." Anakin asks "What about Padmé?" Obi-Wan observes that "she seems to be on top of things," and indeed she is, While no one was looking, Padmé concealed a wire in her mouth and smuggled it into the arena. Now she's used it to pick the Iock of her hand restraints and climb to the top of the post.
back_description: Natalie Portman poses atop her arena post against a blue screen background.
